meta.title: Condensed view
meta.description: Appends a 「速览」 block below each assistant reply: prose compressed into a shorter, conclusion-first version, with numbers, code, paths, and commands kept verbatim. Manual by default—click 「› 速览」 below a reply to generate; switch to 「本会话」 or 「全部」 inside the block for automatic mode, and pick the model that writes it from those configured in DSH. The original reply and the session context stay untouched, and each generation makes one model call that may incur charges.
